blind.description: An antique-style terrestrial floor globe mounted in a brass meridian arc, set within a circular wooden stand. The stand features four turned wooden legs connected by a central cross stretcher at the base. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and well-modeled with realistic textures: a vintage parchment-and-green map on the spherical globe, polished metallic brass for the meridian bracket, and dark reddish-brown polished wood for the frame and legs.
blind.from_above: A circular brown wooden rim enclosing a globe sphere, bisected horizontally across the top by a gold-coloured arched brass meridian band with a central finial.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.3 ft / 70 cm tall) and about 1.8 ft (55 cm) wide.
